description: dispatch() returns Response::no_article_with_number() (423) for NEXT/LAST when group is selected. lifecycle.rs never intercepts NEXT/LAST to advance ctx.selected_group.article_number. RFC 3977 §6.1.3/§6.1.4 require NEXT/LAST to move the article pointer and return 223 with the new number, or 421/422 at end/start. The actual navigation logic is entirely absent — newsreader clients that use NEXT to iterate will always get 423.
title: NEXT/LAST always return 423 without advancing pointer
